x86_64-linux.why: macos-only supported_platforms; pkg is not an installable linux kind either

aarch64-darwin.why: upstream fixture has both app and binary stanzas; summary kind app+cli

x86_64-linux.why: no x86_64_linux tag in this adapted fixture

aarch64-darwin.why: platform gate runs before artifacts; app_image would also be darwin-refused

x86_64-linux.why: app_image is linux-installable; the .AppImage suffix is stripped from the target name

aarch64-darwin.why: no arm64_sequoia variation exists, so the base record serves darwin
